title: 第十九章 矿石收音机第二十章 自行车之争
slug: 诸天影视从四合院开始
content_zh:
“好了，我要说的也就这些，二大爷，三大爷，你们看还有什么需要补充的吗？”
易中海讲完，把话头递给了刘海中和阎埠贵，这是他们的老套路了，不然怎么能叫刷存在感呢。
刘海中卡巴着他的小三角眼，看了看下面坐着小马扎子在那里抱着膀子的邻居，沉吟了一下，开口说道：
“那我就再补充几点！”
然后就是一通巴拉巴拉的滔滔不绝，听的底下的邻居是一阵阵的暗暗骂娘，这群老家伙忒不是个东西，大冬天的把大家伙叫到院当腰来开会，真特么损。
你说你们大事办不了，小事当大事办，呆着没事儿老折腾大家伙有意思吗？
当然有意思，他们开会的目的也无非是在这群人面前刷刷存在感，以彰显他们的不平凡。
叶晨抱着肩膀看着三个大爷的表情，脸上始终是笑眯眯的。
在没有绝对实力的时候，韬光养晦才是自己最好的选择，时不时的使使坏，调剂一下单调的生活，那是无所谓的，但是要叶晨去跟这些人硬刚，叶晨才不会去做那么无脑的事情。
正在这时，一个颤颤巍巍的身影拄着拐棍走了出来，只见她来到了易中海的面前，开口问道：
“小易啊，我刚才隐隐约约的听到傻柱被抓起来了，我没听错吧？”
易中海看了眼聋老太，这是这个院子里辈分最大的人了，也就只有她能叫自己小易。
易中海深知聋老太对傻柱的感情有多深，傻柱是她从小看着长大的孩子，她是五保户，孤身一人，一定是在傻柱身上看到了自己亲人的影子，要不然也不会对那个傻小子那么亲近。
想到这里，易中海的表情有些复杂，开口说道：
“聋老太，你没听错，傻柱因为绑架，故意伤害许大茂，现在已经被派出所抓起来了，正等着审判呢。”
聋老太好像是被人施了定身术似的，僵硬的站在那里，久久之后，才长叹了一声，拄着她的拐棍朝着自己住的屋子走去。
叶晨冷冷的看着她的离开，心里没有一丝怜悯，他知道聋老太是五保户，傻柱能一直照顾她说明这个人哪怕再混不吝，心眼儿还是实诚的，反观聋老太是怎么做的呢？她私下里居然提点易中海，让易中海使用道德绑架的手段，将傻柱给牢牢地捆住，给这个老绝户养老送终。
在叶晨看来，这部剧里几乎是没有一个人是无辜的。
会议的进程被聋老太打断，三个大爷也再没了拿把过领导瘾的意思，随便的敷衍了几句，大伙就被解散了，叶晨回到了自己的屋子，给炉子里填了几块煤球，暖了下手，然后回屋坐在了炕上。
前阵子光顾着处理傻柱和许大茂的事情，现在他俩的事情已经告一段落，也是时候忙活点自己的事情了。

出了四合院不远的地方，有一家废品收购站，平时街坊四邻家里有什么不用的破烂都会往这里送，一次偶然的机会，叶晨来卖酒瓶子，在这里发现了几样宝贝，跟老板打了声招呼，老板一看，都没要叶晨的钱，就送给了他，因为委实不是啥值钱玩意，就是几个电阻，导线，电容和二极管之类的东西。
现实里叶晨是个DIY爱好者，打小就喜欢组装这些小玩意，还没成年的时候，他就受自己父亲的影响，迷上了无线电，自己组装出了第一台矿石收音机。
在这个时代，几乎没有什么娱乐活动，能时不时的听听广播，也是件不错的事情，还能及时的了解些社会新闻，把握时代脉搏。
说干就干，叶晨撸胳膊挽袖子的拿出了前阵子拾掇好的东西，开始了实操。
矿石收音机是一个简单的无线电接收机，由长导线天线，用于选择信号频率的调谐器和检波器组成。
检波器可以使用矿石，也可使用检波二极管，还可以使用锗高频三极管检波器。
制作简易矿石收音机的材料很简单，也很少，只要一些导线、几个电阻、电容还有晶体二极管。
前面三样东西都十分常见，很好弄到，但是最后这个晶体二极管可不是什么好弄到的东西，市场上几乎没有流通的，所以，这时候就需要用特定的矿石来替代晶体二极管，当做检波器来使用，这就是矿石收音机的由来。
叶晨先是在纸筒上用漆包线绕制线圈，九十圈，可以在头尾处钻一个眼，把线穿过去，用胶带粘好。
然后小心地把漆包线的漆去掉，叶晨用砂纸将漆一点点的磨干净
接着叶晨把可变电容连在它的两边，为了确定电容的两极，叶晨特意托人借了个万用表，用它量了一下，相互电阻为无穷大的就是电容的两极，然后用电烙铁配合松香焊锡把它焊上，使之更加牢固。
接着把二极管的随便一极连在可变电容与线圈相连的随便一极上。
接着叶晨把淘换的喇叭分别与二极管的另一极，可变电容的另一极（没连二极管的一级）相连。
剩下的工作就简单了，连上天线和地线，这个工程就可以圆满完成了，叶晨在可变电容，二极管，线圈相连的地方接上天线，就是一段导线，叶晨把它顺着窗户送出了屋外的房顶上，然后在可变电容，喇叭，线圈相连的地方连上了地线叶晨把地线绑在了自家的水管子上。
叶晨不断调整着金属指针在矿石上的位置，这就是“矿机”
上的检波的声音，开始不断变化逐渐出现各种电台的含糊不清的声音，接上天线之后，收听效果大大增强，他刚刚随便调整了几下，就已经听到了好几个电台，其中一个电台距离这里非常远。
叶晨继续仔细地调整着，终于，耳机中传来了“中央人民广播电台”
播音员的声音，而且音质非常好。
叶晨会心的一笑，总算是大功告成了，看来自己的手艺还没荒废，叶晨把自己前几天用边角料钉的一个木头盒子，将矿石收音机的零部件小心的装在了里面，看着这个简易版的收音机，叶晨充满了一种前所未有的成就感。

content_en:
"Okay, that's all I have to say. Second uncle, third uncle, do you think there is anything else you need to add?"
After Yi Zhonghai finished speaking, he handed the words to Liu Haizhong and Yan Bugui. This is their old routine, otherwise how can they be called to gain a sense of presence.
With his little triangular eyes open in his bangs, he looked at his neighbor sitting below, holding his arms in a small pony. He pondered for a moment and said:
"Then I will add a few more points!"
Then there was a lot of chattering, and the neighbors below were scolding each other secretly. These old guys are such a big deal. It is really a shame to call these big guys to the courtyard to host a meeting in the middle of winter.
You said you can't handle big things, treat small things like big things, and keep tossing the big guys while you have nothing to do. Isn't it interesting?
Of course it's interesting. The purpose of their meeting is nothing more than to establish their presence in front of this group of people to show that they are extraordinary.
Ye Chen hugged his shoulders and looked at the expressions of the three uncles, with a smile on his face.
When you don't have absolute strength, keeping a low profile is your best choice. It doesn't matter if you do something bad from time to time to spice up your monotonous life. But if Ye Chen has to fight these people hard, Ye Chen will not do such mindless things.
At this moment, a trembling figure came out with a cane. She came to Yi Zhonghai and asked:
"Xiao Yi, I just vaguely heard that Sha Zhu was arrested. Did I hear it correctly?"
Yi Zhonghai glanced at the deaf old lady. She was the oldest person in the yard, and she was the only one who could call him Xiao Yi.
Yi Zhonghai knew very well how deep the deaf old lady's feelings were for Silly Zhu. Silly Zhu was the child she had watched since childhood. She was a five-guaranteed household and was alone. She must have seen the shadow of her relatives in Silly Zhu, otherwise she would not be so close to that silly boy.
Thinking of this, Yi Zhonghai's expression was a little complicated and he said:
"Deaf old lady, you heard me right. Silly Zhu intentionally hurt Xu Damao because of the kidnapping. He has been arrested by the police station and is awaiting trial."
The deaf old lady stood there stiffly as if someone had cast a restraining spell on her body. After a long time, she sighed and walked toward her house with her crutch.
Ye Chen watched her leave coldly, without a trace of pity in his heart. He knew that the deaf old lady was a household with five guarantees. The fact that Silly Zhu could always take care of her showed that no matter how generous he was, he was still sincere. On the other hand, what did the deaf old lady do? She actually gave Yi Zhonghai some advice in private and asked Yi Zhonghai to use moral kidnapping to tie up Silly Zhu tightly and provide this old homeless man with a pension until the end of his life.
In Ye Chen's opinion, almost no one in this drama is innocent.
The meeting was interrupted by a deaf old lady. The three uncles no longer had the intention to lead. After a few casual remarks, everyone was dismissed. Ye Chen returned to his room, filled a few briquettes into the stove, warmed his hands, and then returned to the room to sit on the kang.
A while ago, I was busy dealing with the affairs of Sha Zhu and Xu Damao. Now that their affairs have come to an end, it's time to get busy with my own affairs.
Not far from the courtyard, there is a scrap collection station. The neighbors usually send all the unused junk here. By chance, Ye Chen came to sell wine bottles and found a few treasures here. He said hello to the boss. When the boss saw it, he didn't even ask for Ye Chen's money and gave it to him because it was not really valuable, just a few resistors, wires, capacitors and diodes.
In reality, Ye Chen is a DIY enthusiast. He has liked to assemble these gadgets since he was a child. Before he was an adult, he was influenced by his father and became obsessed with radios, and assembled his first mineral radio.
In this era, there are almost no entertainment activities that can be used from time to time.Listening to the radio from time to time is also a good thing. You can also understand some social news in a timely manner and grasp the pulse of the times.
Just do it, Ye Chen rolled up his arms and sleeves, took out the things he had packed up a while ago, and started to do the actual operation.
A rock radio is a simple radio receiver consisting of a long wire antenna, a tuner and a detector for selecting the frequency of the signal.
The detector can use minerals, detector diodes, or germanium high-frequency transistor detectors.
The materials used to make a simple mineral radio are very simple and few, just some wires, a few resistors, capacitors and crystal diodes.
The first three items are very common and easy to get, but the last crystal diode is not something easy to get, and there is almost no circulation in the market. Therefore, at this time, it is necessary to replace the crystal diode with a specific ore and use it as a detector. This is the origin of the ore radio.
Ye Chen first wound a coil with enameled wire on a paper tube, ninety times. He could drill a hole at the head and tail, pass the wire through, and stick it with tape.
Then carefully remove the paint from the enameled wire, and Ye Chen used sandpaper to clean the paint bit by bit.
Then Ye Chen connected the variable capacitor to both sides of it. In order to determine the two poles of the capacitor, Ye Chen asked someone to borrow a multimeter and measured it. The poles with infinite mutual resistance were the two poles of the capacitor. He then used a soldering iron and rosin solder to solder it to make it stronger.
Then connect any pole of the diode to any pole of the variable capacitor connected to the coil.
Then Ye Chen connected the replaced speaker to the other pole of the diode and the other pole of the variable capacitor (the first stage not connected to the diode).
The rest of the work is simple. Connect the antenna and ground wire, and the project will be completed successfully. Ye Chen connects the antenna, which is a piece of wire, to the place where the variable capacitor, diode, and coil are connected. Ye Chen sends it out through the window to the roof outside the house, and then connects the ground wire to the place where the variable capacitor, speaker, and coil are connected. Ye Chen tied the ground wire to his own water pipe.
Ye Chen constantly adjusted the position of the metal pointer on the ore. This is the "mining machine"
The sound of the detector on the radio began to change, and the vague sounds of various radio stations gradually appeared. After connecting the antenna, the listening effect was greatly enhanced. He had just made a few adjustments and heard several radio stations, one of which was very far away from here.
Ye Chen continued to adjust carefully, and finally, "Central People's Broadcasting Station" came from the earphones.
The announcer's voice, and the sound quality is very good.
Ye Chen smiled knowingly, and finally he was done. It seemed that his craftsmanship was not yet wasted. Ye Chen put a wooden box that he had nailed with scraps a few days ago and carefully packed the parts of the ore radio inside. Looking at this simple version of the radio, Ye Chen was filled with an unprecedented sense of accomplishment.
